title: The Rivet Rain
text: The forge's ruined roof hangs overhead, a sky of rusted iron plates. Each time the wind blows through it, rivets come loose and fall like hail, hot from the sun, hard enough to crack a skull. The floor below is studded with them.

outcomes.text: Across, with a few dents in the helms.
A big gust, and iron hail, and ringing heads.

options.label: The sharpest eye times the wind.

outcomes.text: Across without a scratch, and a pocketful of rivets.

options.label: The strongest holds a door over everyone's heads.

outcomes.text: It rings like a bell all the way across, and their arms ring with it.
